```{r setup}
DATOS <- params$datos
source("R/leer.R")
source("R/tema.R")
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(forcats)
  library(stringr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(knitr)
})

meta     <- leer_metadata()
lecturas <- leer_lecturas()
N_MUESTRAS <- nrow(lecturas)
K_POOL     <- unique(meta$individuos_pool)
stopifnot(length(K_POOL) == 1)

# sections that need the integrated vOTU table are skipped if it is missing
HAY_VOTUS <- existe("TABLA_FINAL_votus_arb.tsv") && existe("votu_coverage.tsv")

# "14 Sep" independent of the system locale
fecha_corta <- function(d) if_else(is.na(d), NA_character_,
                                   paste(as.integer(format(d, "%d")), month.abb[as.integer(format(d, "%m"))]))
```

Data: **`r DATOS`** · `r N_MUESTRAS` pools of `r K_POOL` unfed females, Mérida (Yucatán, Mexico), Sep–Oct 2024.

# 1. Reads

```{r g-reads, fig.height = 5.2}
DESTINOS <- c(descartadas = "Removed by trimming",
              huesped     = "Host (Ae. aegypti)",
              no_huesped  = "Non-host")

lec <- lecturas |>
  transmute(muestra, raw_pairs,
            descartadas = raw_pairs - trimmed_pairs,
            huesped     = trimmed_pairs - unmapped_pairs,
            no_huesped  = unmapped_pairs) |>
  pivot_longer(c(descartadas, huesped, no_huesped), names_to = "destino", values_to = "pares") |>
  group_by(muestra) |>
  mutate(frac = pares / sum(pares)) |>
  ungroup()

nh <- lec |> filter(destino == "no_huesped") |> arrange(frac)
atipicas <- nh |> filter(frac > 0.4) |> pull(muestra)
etiq <- setNames(paste0(etiqueta_muestra(nh$muestra), if_else(nh$muestra %in% atipicas, " *", "")), nh$muestra)

lec <- lec |>
  mutate(etiqueta = factor(etiq[muestra], levels = unname(etiq)),
         destino  = factor(destino, levels = names(DESTINOS)))

totales <- lec |> distinct(etiqueta, raw_pairs)

p1 <- ggplot(lec, aes(frac, etiqueta, fill = destino)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  geom_text(data = totales, aes(x = 1.01, y = etiqueta, label = millones(raw_pairs)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 2.7, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(descartadas = GRIS, huesped = PAL[["azul"]], no_huesped = PAL[["naranja"]]),
                    labels = DESTINOS) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.09)),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
  labs(title = "Fate of the reads in each pool",
       subtitle = "Fraction of raw read pairs; total raw pairs on the right",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = str_wrap(paste0("* More than 40% non-host reads (", paste(etiqueta_muestra(atipicas), collapse = ", "),
                                 "). Viral abundance is normalised by trimmed pairs, not by non-host pairs."),
                          width = 120)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
guardar(p1, "01_reads", alto = 130)
p1
```

# 2. Assembly

```{r g-assembly, fig.height = 6.5}
contigs <- leer_contigs() |>
  mutate(ens = factor(ENSAMBLADORES[ensamblador], levels = ENSAMBLADORES))

col_ens <- setNames(unname(PAL[1:length(ENSAMBLADORES)]), ENSAMBLADORES)

por_muestra <- contigs |>
  count(muestra, ens) |>
  mutate(etiqueta = etiqueta_muestra(muestra))
orden_m <- por_muestra |> group_by(etiqueta) |> summarise(n = sum(n)) |> arrange(n) |> pull(etiqueta)

p2a <- ggplot(por_muestra, aes(n, factor(etiqueta, levels = orden_m), fill = ens)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_ens, drop = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "contigs in the dereplicated union", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

n_ens <- contigs |> count(ens)
p2b <- ggplot(contigs, aes(longitud, ens, colour = ens)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.4, outlier.alpha = 0.4, width = 0.55, linewidth = 0.4, fill = NA) +
  geom_text(data = n_ens, aes(x = Inf, y = ens, label = paste0("n = ", format(n, big.mark = ","))),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.9, size = 2.6, colour = TINTA_2) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = label_number(big.mark = ","), breaks = c(1e3, 3e3, 1e4, 3e4)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_ens, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "contig length (bp, log scale)", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

p2 <- (p2a / p2b) + plot_layout(heights = c(2.2, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(title = "Contigs in the union, by assembler",
                  subtitle = paste0(format(nrow(contigs), big.mark = ","), " contigs ≥ 1,000 bp from ",
                                    n_distinct(contigs$ens), " assemblers, dereplicated per sample"))
guardar(p2, "02_assembly", alto = 170)
p2
```

# 3. Quality of viral contigs (CheckV)

```{r g-checkv, fig.height = 4}
NIVELES_CV <- c("Complete", "High-quality", "Medium-quality", "Low-quality", "Not-determined")
cv <- leer_checkv() |>
  mutate(ens = factor(ENSAMBLADORES[ensamblador], levels = ENSAMBLADORES),
         calidad = factor(checkv_quality, levels = NIVELES_CV)) |>
  count(ens, calidad)

col_cv <- setNames(c(rev(AZUL_ORD), GRIS), NIVELES_CV)

p3 <- ggplot(cv, aes(n, fct_rev(ens), fill = calidad)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_cv, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "CheckV quality of viral contigs (geNomad)",
       subtitle = paste0(format(sum(cv$n), big.mark = ","), " contigs; ",
                         round(100 * sum(cv$n[cv$calidad == "Not-determined"], na.rm = TRUE) / sum(cv$n)),
                         "% not determined (fragments without reference genes)"),
       x = "contigs", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1))
guardar(p3, "03_checkv", alto = 85)
p3
```

```{r table-checkv}
cv |>
  arrange(calidad) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = calidad, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  rename(Assembler = ens) |>
  kable()
```

# 4. From contig to virus

```{r g-funnel, eval = HAY_VOTUS, fig.height = 3.8}
votus <- leer_votus()
gen   <- leer_tsv("genomad_virus_summary.tsv")
etapas <- tibble(
  etapa = c("Contigs in the union", "Viral according to geNomad", "vOTUs (95% id, 85% cov.)",
            "Viral vOTUs", "Viral species"),
  n = c(nrow(leer_contigs()), nrow(gen), nrow(votus),
        sum(votus$es_virus == "si"),
        votus |> filter(es_virus == "si") |>
          mutate(e = nombre_virus(pick(everything()))) |> pull(e) |> n_distinct())
) |>
  mutate(etapa = factor(etapa, levels = rev(etapa)))

diamond_viral <- if (existe("veredicto_contigs.tsv")) {
  sum(leer_veredicto_contigs()$veredicto == "viral", na.rm = TRUE)
} else NA

p4 <- ggplot(etapas, aes(n, etapa)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, fill = PAL[["azul"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(label = format(n, big.mark = ",")), hjust = -0.15, size = 3, colour = TINTA) +
  scale_x_log10(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.15)), labels = label_number(big.mark = ",")) +
  labs(title = "From contig to virus",
       subtitle = "Main path: geNomad → CheckV → vOTUs → annotation and nr arbiter",
       x = "n (log scale)", y = NULL,
       caption = if (!is.na(diamond_viral))
         str_wrap(paste0("Parallel path: DIAMOND on all ", format(etapas$n[1], big.mark = ","),
                         " contigs calls ", diamond_viral,
                         " viral, including viruses geNomad missed (nudivirus in M71, Guadeloupe mosquito virus)."),
                  width = 120)) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
guardar(p4, "04_funnel", alto = 80)
p4
```

# 5. vOTU classification

```{r g-classes, eval = HAY_VOTUS, fig.height = 6.5}
GRUPO <- c(identificado = "Virus", pariente = "Virus", divergente = "Virus", pariente_debil = "Virus", viral_solo_nr = "Virus",
           EVE_genoma = "EVE", EVE_candidato = "EVE",
           huesped = "Host / cellular", celular_otro = "Host / cellular",
           rRNA = "Artefact", ADN_descartado = "Artefact",
           oscura = "Unresolved", ambiguo = "Unresolved", sin_hit = "Unresolved",
           evidencia_debil = "Unresolved")
col_grupo <- c("Virus" = PAL[["azul"]], "EVE" = PAL[["naranja"]], "Host / cellular" = PAL[["aqua"]],
               "Artefact" = GRIS, "Unresolved" = PAL[["violeta"]])

ETIQ_CLASE <- c(identificado = "Identified virus (≥ 90% nt)", pariente = "Relative (putative new species)",
                divergente = "Divergent virus",
                pariente_debil = "Distant relative", viral_solo_nr = "Viral in nr only",
                EVE_genoma = "EVE in host genome", EVE_candidato = "Candidate EVE",
                huesped = "Host", celular_otro = "Other cellular",
                rRNA = "rRNA", ADN_descartado = "DNA family (discarded)",
                oscura = "No hit in any database", ambiguo = "Ambiguous", sin_hit = "No hit",
                evidencia_debil = "Weak evidence (short nt hit only)")

cl <- votus |>
  count(clase_final) |>
  mutate(grupo = factor(GRUPO[clase_final], levels = names(col_grupo)),
         etiqueta = coalesce(ETIQ_CLASE[clase_final], clase_final),
         etiqueta = fct_reorder(etiqueta, n))

p5a <- ggplot(cl, aes(n, etiqueta, fill = grupo)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 2.8, colour = TINTA) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_grupo, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "vOTUs", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

fam <- votus |>
  filter(es_virus == "si") |>
  mutate(familia = coalesce(na_if(familia, ""), "unassigned family")) |>
  count(familia) |>
  mutate(familia = fct_relevel(fct_reorder(familia, n), "unassigned family"))

p5b <- ggplot(fam, aes(n, familia)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.65, fill = PAL[["azul"]]) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), hjust = -0.2, size = 2.8, colour = TINTA) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(c(0, 0.12))) +
  labs(x = "viral vOTUs", y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())

p5 <- (p5a | p5b) + plot_layout(guides = "collect", widths = c(1.1, 1)) +
  plot_annotation(title = paste0("Classification of the ", nrow(votus), " vOTUs"),
                  subtitle = "Left: final class after the nr arbiter and the AaegL5 screen. Right: families of the viral vOTUs (phages included)") &
  theme(legend.position = "top")
guardar(p5, "05_classification", alto = 120, ancho = 200)
p5
```

```{r table-eve, eval = HAY_VOTUS}
votus |>
  filter(clase_final %in% c("EVE_genoma", "EVE_candidato")) |>
  transmute(vOTU = votu,
            Class = if_else(clase_final == "EVE_genoma", "EVE in genome", "Candidate EVE"),
            `Viral hit` = especie,
            `nr (cellular)` = celular_nombre, `Fraction in AaegL5` = frac_en_genoma,
            Chromosomes = cromosomas_genoma) |>
  arrange(Class, desc(`Fraction in AaegL5`)) |>
  kable(caption = "vOTUs with a viral hit whose sequence is mosquito (EVE in genome), or whose best nr hit is an arthropod but which are absent from the reference (candidate EVE, pending small RNA).")
```

# 6. Prevalence and infection rate

```{r g-prevalence, eval = HAY_VOTUS, fig.height = 5.5}
cob <- leer_cobertura()
pres <- presencia_especies(votus, cob, lecturas)

orden_muestras <- meta |>
  arrange(is.na(fecha), fecha, muestra) |>
  pull(muestra)
prev <- pres |> count(especie_fig, grupo, name = "pools") |> arrange(pools)

hm <- pres |>
  mutate(especie_fig = factor(especie_fig, levels = prev$especie_fig),
         muestra = factor(muestra, levels = orden_muestras))
prev_f <- prev |> mutate(especie_fig = factor(especie_fig, levels = prev$especie_fig))

p6 <- ggplot(hm, aes(muestra, especie_fig, fill = prof_norm)) +
  geom_tile(colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(data = prev_f, aes(x = Inf, y = especie_fig, label = paste0(pools, "/", N_MUESTRAS)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.2, size = 2.7, colour = TINTA_2) +
  facet_grid(rows = vars(grupo), scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y",
             labeller = as_labeller(c("Arthropod viruses" = "Arthropod", "Phages (microbiota)" = "Phages"))) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = AZUL_SEQ, trans = "log10", labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01),
                       name = "depth per million trimmed pairs") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = etiqueta_muestra, drop = FALSE) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(title = "Prevalence of viral species across pools",
       subtitle = "Present: ≥ 70% of the genome covered at ≥ 1×. Pools ordered by collection date; positive pools on the right",
       x = NULL, y = NULL,
       caption = "X-like: a relative of X below 90% nucleotide identity, with its amino-acid identity in brackets; not a detection of X.") +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, size = 8, face = "bold", colour = TINTA_2),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 8, colour = TINTA_2),
        plot.margin = margin(5, 40, 5, 5)) +
  guides(fill = guide_colourbar(title.position = "top", barwidth = unit(55, "mm"), barheight = unit(3, "mm")))
guardar(p6, "06_prevalence", alto = 120, ancho = 200)
p6
```

```{r g-assembly-vs-mapping, eval = HAY_VOTUS, fig.height = 5}
asm <- votus |>
  filter(es_virus == "si") |>
  mutate(especie_fig = nombre_virus(pick(everything()))) |>
  group_by(especie_fig) |>
  summarise(ensamblaje = max(n_muestras_asm), .groups = "drop")
comp <- prev |> rename(mapeo = pools) |> inner_join(asm, by = "especie_fig") |>
  mutate(especie_fig = factor(especie_fig, levels = prev$especie_fig))
comp_l <- comp |> pivot_longer(c(mapeo, ensamblaje), names_to = "via", values_to = "pools") |>
  mutate(via = factor(via, levels = c("ensamblaje", "mapeo"),
                      labels = c("Assembled in the pool", "Detected by read mapping")))

p6b <- ggplot(comp_l, aes(pools, especie_fig)) +
  geom_segment(data = comp, aes(x = ensamblaje, xend = mapeo, y = especie_fig, yend = especie_fig),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = REJILLA, linewidth = 1.6) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = via), size = 2.6) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Assembled in the pool" = PAL[["naranja"]], "Detected by read mapping" = PAL[["azul"]])) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, N_MUESTRAS), breaks = seq(0, N_MUESTRAS, 5)) +
  labs(title = "Assembly underestimates prevalence",
       subtitle = "Pools in which each species was assembled versus pools in which it is detected by read mapping",
       x = paste0("pools (of ", N_MUESTRAS, ")"), y = NULL) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
guardar(p6b, "06b_assembly_vs_mapping", alto = 110)
p6b
```

```{r table-rate, eval = HAY_VOTUS}
prev |>
  filter(grupo == GRUPOS_VIRUS[["artropodo"]]) |>
  arrange(desc(pools)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(t = list(tasa_infeccion(pools, N_MUESTRAS, K_POOL))) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(especie_fig, t) |>
  unnest(t) |>
  transmute(Species = especie_fig,
            `Positive pools` = paste0(pools_pos, "/", N_MUESTRAS),
            `MIR (‰)` = round(mir, 1),
            `MLE (‰)` = if_else(pools_pos == N_MUESTRAS, NA_real_, round(mle, 1)),
            `95% CI` = if_else(pools_pos == N_MUESTRAS, "all pools positive",
                                paste0(round(mle_inf, 1), "–", round(mle_sup, 1)))) |>
  kable(caption = paste0("Individual infection rate per 1,000 females (pools of ", K_POOL,
                         "). MLE after Chiang and Reeves with a transformed Clopper-Pearson CI; not estimable when all pools are positive."))
```

# 7. Viral richness per pool

```{r g-richness, eval = HAY_VOTUS, fig.height = 4.2}
riq <- pres |>
  filter(grupo == GRUPOS_VIRUS[["artropodo"]]) |>
  count(muestra, name = "especies") |>
  right_join(select(meta, muestra, fecha), by = "muestra") |>
  mutate(especies = coalesce(especies, 0L),
         colecta = coalesce(fecha_corta(fecha), "Mixed"),
         colecta = factor(colecta, levels = unique(colecta[order(is.na(fecha), fecha)])),
         muestra = factor(muestra, levels = orden_muestras))

niv <- levels(riq$colecta)
col_fecha <- setNames(rep(GRIS, length(niv)), niv)
con_fecha <- niv != "Mixed"
col_fecha[con_fecha] <- unname(PAL[seq_len(sum(con_fecha))])

p7 <- ggplot(riq, aes(muestra, especies, fill = colecta)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_fecha) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = etiqueta_muestra) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(title = "Arthropod virus species detected per pool",
       subtitle = "Colour: collection date (2024). Phages excluded", x = NULL, y = "species") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7))
guardar(p7, "07_richness", alto = 95)
p7
```

# 8. Non-viral composition (Kraken2 + Bracken, non-host reads)

```{r g-kraken, fig.height = 5.5}
br <- leer_bracken()
TOP <- 7
top <- br |>
  group_by(name) |>
  summarise(media = sum(fraction_total_reads) / N_MUESTRAS, .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(media, n = TOP) |>
  pull(name)

kr <- br |>
  mutate(taxon = if_else(name %in% top, name, "Other")) |>
  group_by(muestra, taxon) |>
  summarise(frac = sum(fraction_total_reads), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(taxon = factor(taxon, levels = c(top, "Other")),
         etiqueta = etiqueta_muestra(muestra))

col_tax <- setNames(c(unname(PAL[seq_len(TOP)]), GRIS), c(top, "Other"))
orden_k <- kr |> filter(taxon == top[1]) |> arrange(frac) |> pull(etiqueta)
kr <- kr |> mutate(etiqueta = factor(etiqueta, levels = union(orden_k, unique(etiqueta))))

p8 <- ggplot(kr, aes(frac, etiqueta, fill = taxon)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, colour = SUPERFICIE, linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_tax) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_percent(), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(title = "Taxonomic composition of non-host reads",
       subtitle = paste0("The ", TOP, " most abundant taxa on average; Bracken level ",
                         paste(unique(br$taxonomy_lvl), collapse = "/")),
       x = "fraction of classified reads", y = NULL,
       caption = "PlusPF contains no insect genomes: residual mosquito reads may be assigned to the closest eukaryote.") +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 3))
guardar(p8, "08_kraken2", alto = 140)
p8
```

# Data used

```{r manifest}
m <- file.path(DATOS, "MANIFEST.tsv")
if (file.exists(m)) {
  cat(paste(readLines(m, n = 2), collapse = "\n"))
  read_tsv(m, comment = "#", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    filter(!str_starts(archivo, "kraken2_nohost/")) |>
    select(File = archivo, Lines = lineas, md5, `Modified at source` = modificado_origen) |>
    kable()
}
```
